title: Managed Database: authoritative metering
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database authoritative metering applies to database meter, database meter reversal, database supplemental meter. The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. Meters originate in the provider resource export. Primary meter quantities use primary usage unit; a meter is positive and a meter reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed. Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference. bill actual usage overage permits measured quantities above included quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write. Round measured quantities to quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum primary quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole meter increment. Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental meter. A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter. Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Evidence: export evidence
The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, external reference, service interval start, service interval end, quantity. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference.
